title: pekarj/bdbv-pipeline-temp
description: Automated pipeline for downloading, cleaning, and building maximum-likelihood phylogenies from Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) genome sequences hosted on Pathoplexus.

input_options.title: Input Options
input_options.description: Where the pipeline finds input data. Leave FASTA unset to download from Pathoplexus.

fasta.title: FASTA
fasta.help_text: Pre-aligned from Pathoplexus, or unaligned if using --mafft. If unset, sequences are downloaded from Pathoplexus.

organism.title: Organism
organism.description: LAPIS organism slug used for download

scope.title: Download scope
scope.description: Countries to download: drc, a comma-separated list (e.g. drc,kenya), or outbreak
scope.help_text: drc applies the Pathogen Genomic Lab group filter.

aliases_file.title: Aliases file
aliases_file.description: CSV mapping observed admin2 location names to canonical names

exclude_file.title: Identity exclusions
exclude_file.description: Accessions to exclude from everything (duplicates, non-consortium, withdrawn)

exclude_quality.title: Quality exclusions
exclude_quality.description: Accessions to exclude from phylogenetics (low quality)

exclude_pending.title: Pending exclusions
exclude_pending.description: Accessions temporarily excluded while under review

output_options.title: Output Options
output_options.description: Where and how outputs are written.

prefix.title: Prefix
prefix.description: Prefix for output file names (default: bdbv_<run_name>, e.g. bdbv_20261026)

run_name.title: Run name
run_name.description: Label for this run used in downloaded file names and retractions (default: today, YYYYMMDD)

tree_options.title: Tree Building Options
tree_options.description: Options for cleaning, ADAR handling and tree building.

mafft.title: Run MAFFT
mafft.description: Align sequences with MAFFT before cleaning
mafft.help_text: Not needed for pre-aligned Pathoplexus sequences.

trim_start.title: Trim start
trim_start.description: First alignment position to keep (1-based, inclusive)

trim_end.title: Trim end
trim_end.description: Last alignment position to keep (1-based, inclusive)

min_date.title: Minimum date
min_date.help_text: Sequences from the same year but before this date are flagged.

model.title: Substitution model
model.description: Use this model (e.g. GTR+F+R3) instead of running ModelFinder

adar_mode.title: ADAR mode
adar_mode.help_text: mask: mask ADAR sites; exclude_tc: exclude T>C genomes; exclude_all: exclude T>C/A>G/G>A genomes. Health checks currently only work with mask.

review_options.title: Review Options
review_options.description: Control the two points where the pipeline can stop for manual review.

outlier_removal_threshold.title: Outlier removal threshold
outlier_removal_threshold.description: Auto-remove temporal outliers with |z| >= this value and continue
outlier_removal_threshold.help_text: If neither this nor --outlier_file is given, the pipeline stops after temporal rooting for review.

outlier_file.title: Outlier file
outlier_file.description: Reviewed outlier exclusion file; continues from outlier filtering
outlier_file.help_text: Use with -resume after editing a copy of the detected outliers file.

previous_data.title: Previous data
previous_data.description: Previous run folder to compare against in health checks
previous_data.help_text: Set for update runs; health checks are skipped when unset.

full_health_check.title: Full health check
full_health_check.description: Run health checks on all genomes, not just new ones

stop_after_health_checks.title: Stop after health checks
stop_after_health_checks.description: Stop before generating BEAST XMLs so health check flags can be reviewed

beast_options.title: BEAST Options
beast_options.description: BEAST XML generation from the final alignment.

beast_xml.title: Generate BEAST XMLs
beast_xml.description: Generate BEAST XMLs from the final alignment

anchor_date.title: Anchor date
anchor_date.description: SkyGrid anchor date; the grid extends from this date to the latest sample

miscellaneous_options.title: Miscellaneous Options
miscellaneous_options.help_text:
These options are common to all nf-core pipelines and allow you to customise some of the core preferences for how the pipeline runs.

Typically these options would be set in a Nextflow config file loaded for all pipeline runs, such as `~/.nextflow/config`.

docs.intro: Automated pipeline for downloading, cleaning, and building maximum-likelihood phylogenies from Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) genome sequences hosted on Pathoplexus.
